name: nc-bioinformatics-figure-skills
description: Plot and review existing single-cell, communication and spatial results through tested R tasks with traceable source data and bounded corrections.

interface.shortDescription: 调用 R 包绘制已有单细胞结果，检查图件、保留源数据并按报告修正。
interface.longDescription: Plot existing results through a version-checked ncfigR/scfigR/commfigR/spfigR runtime. Atlas, communication and spatial tasks export source tables, checks and reproducible artwork for visual review. The Agent corrects presentation without silently changing scientific inputs. Additional domains and paper/code learning remain on-demand references.
defaultPrompt: Use nc-bioinformatics-figure-skills to plot and review existing single-cell results through the fixed ncfigR/scfigR runtime. Inspect inputs, execute the task, review reports and artwork, then correct presentation in a new attempt. Load paper/code learning, broader figure planning or other-domain references only when the user explicitly requests them.
